question: Why are electronics SKUs out of stock in the North region in March?

open_items.statement: North Electronics sold only 140 units across 35 March rows, far below every other region-category combination, consistent with the planted stockout.
reasons: the query filters the table before analysing it, so the groups it compares are a subset of the 4681 row(s) the dataset holds, not the whole population

implications: Electronics in North ran a March stockout pattern (35 rows, 140 units) that the other region-category groups did not; treat on_hand policy and lead time as the candidate causes and re-run before acting.
